name: Personnel absence
description: Threats pertaining to limited availability of critical staff, or lack thereof, at any of the satellite lifecycle phases. Personnel absence may result in loss/unavailiability of relevant information and inability to complete tasks, comply with prescribed roles and responsibilities, or enforce the four-eyes principle for risk and quality assurance.
